title: Chicken Salad – Grilled With Nectarines & Basil
description: This vibrant salad celebrates the best of summer, pairing smoky grilled chicken thighs with charred nectarines, creamy cheese, crunchy nuts, and an abundance of fresh herbs. Rather than playing a supporting role, basil takes center stage alongside peppery arugula and cooling mint, creating a bright, fragrant base for the grilled ingredients.
ingredients: 1 teaspoon grated lime zest plus 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice
4 large boneless, skinless chicken thighs (about 1 1/2 pounds)
2 cups loosely packed mixed fresh basil leaves (about 1 ounce)
1 1/2 cups loosely packed fresh baby arugula (about 1 ounce)
1/2 cup loosely packed fresh mint leaves
1/3 cup roasted salted marcona almonds, roughly chopped
directions: Make the chicken and nectarines: Stir together garlic, lime zest and juice, salt, honey, paprika, black pepper, and 2 tablespoons oil in a large bowl. Add chicken thighs; toss to coat evenly. Rub nectarines with remaining 1 tablespoon oil. Set aside.

Preheat grill to medium-high (400°F to 450°F). Place chicken on oiled grates; grill, uncovered, until lightly charred on both sides and a thermometer inserted into thickest portion of chicken registers 165°F, 5 to 6 minutes per side. Transfer chicken to a platter; tent with foil to keep warm.

Place nectarines, cut sides down, on oiled grates; grill, uncovered, until grill marks form and fruit is just tender, about 2 minutes per side. Transfer to a cutting board, and cut into wedges. Season lightly with flaky sea salt to taste; set aside.

Make the salad: Whisk together vinegar, mustard, salt, and pepper in a large bowl. Gradually whisk in oil until emulsified. Add basil, arugula, mint, almonds, onion, cheese, and nectarines; toss gently to coat.
Spoon salad over grilled chicken on platter. Serve immediately.
